reason: RangePrimitive.supersedes requires an exact retained source predecessor; a digest of stream identity and ordinal alone is not a predecessor content identity. SharedBar has a revision ordinal but no serialized predecessor field.
decision: Within the registered narrow F09 retained-publication lookup extension, also expose window_publication_predecessor(publication_version_id: str) -> str | None. Keep window_publication return (SharedBar, WindowRequest) and all existing serialized records unchanged.
contract: Return the exact retained immediately preceding time-window publication version_id in the same source stream, or None for the first publication.
Maintain the predecessor reference alongside the bounded O(1) window-publication index at successful publish; restore reconstructs both through existing checked replay.
Malformed ID raises ContractError; unknown or activity-result ID raises DependencyUnavailable.
RangePrimitive.supersedes binds this exact predecessor publication ID and documents that namespace separately from RangePrimitive.version_id.
Existing registered correction/restart/forgery cases must assert this exact binding; no synthetic predecessor digest or per-call full-history scan.
